high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "narendramodi." The post shows a group of individuals taking a selfie under a white tent-like structure. The person on the left is holding up a smartphone to capture the photo, while the others are standing close together, smiling or looking at the camera. The group consists of several men dressed in formal attire. One individual is wearing a traditional orange Nehru jacket over a white kurta, which is often associated with Indian attire. Another man is wearing a dark suit with a light blue tie.
